text:
Grab's full-time headcount increased from 11,267 at the end of 2024 to 12,012 at the end of 2025, an increase of 745 employees, or approximately 6.6% [Grab, FY2024, p.161; Grab, FY2025, p.117].

Breaking this down by function:
- General and administrative: decreased from 1,425 to 1,375
- Sales and marketing: decreased from 853 to 785
- Operations, support and supermarket retail: increased from 6,055 to 6,888 (the largest driver of growth)
- Research and development: increased from 2,934 to 2,964

[Grab, FY2024, p.161]; [Grab, FY2025, p.117]

Note that the FY2025 total includes 865 employees from Everrise (a Malaysian supermarket chain acquired in March 2025) and 22 employees from Infermove (acquired December 2025), while the FY2024 total included 321 employees from Nham24 (acquired December 2024) — so part of the year-over-year increase reflects acquisitions rather than organic growth [Grab, FY2025, p.117].
